insert into [rpy].[Gl_code_combinations]
(CODE_COMBINATION_ID,CONCATENATED_SEGMENTS,CONCAT_DESCRIPTION,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,SEGM1_DESCRIPTION,
SEGM2_DESCRIPTION,SEGM3_DESCRIPTION,SEGM4_DESCRIPTION,SEGM5_DESCRIPTION,SEGM6_DESCRIPTION,
SEGM7_DESCRIPTION,SEGM8_DESCRIPTION,SEGM9_DESCRIPTION,SEGMENT1,SEGMENT2,SEGMENT3,SEGMENT4,
SEGMENT5,SEGMENT6,SEGMENT7,SEGMENT8,SEGMENT9,source_name,sub_source_name,created_date_time)
select
a.CODE_COMBINATION_ID,a.CONCATENATED_SEGMENTS,a.CONCAT_DESCRIPTION,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.SEGM1_DESCRIPTION,a.
SEGM2_DESCRIPTION,a.SEGM3_DESCRIPTION,a.SEGM4_DESCRIPTION,a.SEGM5_DESCRIPTION,a.SEGM6_DESCRIPTION,a.
SEGM7_DESCRIPTION,a.SEGM8_DESCRIPTION,a.SEGM9_DESCRIPTION,a.SEGMENT1,a.SEGMENT2,a.SEGMENT3,a.SEGMENT4,a.
SEGMENT5,a.SEGMENT6,a.SEGMENT7,a.SEGMENT8,a.SEGMENT9,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time
from [rpy].[Gl_code_combinations_stage] a,
(select CODE_COMBINATION_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Gl_code_combinations_stage]
group by CODE_COMBINATION_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE) b
where a.CODE_COMBINATION_ID = b.CODE_COMBINATION_ID
and a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
